skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply blockchain technology, including consensus algorithms and smart contracts.
Develop and deploy smart contracts using Solidity and other programming languages.
Work with popular blockchain platforms like Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, and Corda.
Implement and secure blockchain applications and smart contracts.
Use programming languages and libraries to develop blockchain applications.
Manage and complete group projects and assignments independently.
Collaborate effectively in group settings and contribute to team projects.
Analyze and solve complex problems related to blockchain technology.
Understand and adhere to ethical and legal standards in blockchain applications.
Self-study and understand complex concepts independently.
